summary: The Goshen Township Board of Trustees held their regular meeting covering a wide range of agenda items including zoning text amendments for accessory structures and accessory dwelling units, renewal of liability insurance, approval of a new police cruiser purchase partially funded by insurance proceeds and the community host fund, acceptance of a traffic safety grant, a presentation on Duke Energy's proposed electric distribution rate increase, and an executive session resulting in the promotion of a staff member to full-time status.
decisions: Approved payment of bills from September 22 to October 13, 2026
Approved elected officials and staff to attend OTA Winter Conference February 10-12 in Columbus
Approved increase in appropriations for cemetery contracted services
Approved indigent burial of Rover Lee Meadows at $906 paid to Evans Funeral Home
Renewed liability insurance with Highland Ohio Plan
Adopted Resolution R43-2026 amending zoning for accessory structure permit requirements and setbacks
Adopted Resolution R44-2026 amending zoning for accessory dwelling units including revised size standards and allowing detached ADUs
Adopted Resolution R45-2026 accepting amounts and rates from Budget Commission and authorizing tax levies
Approved out-of-town travel for Chief Myers to attend FDIC in Indianapolis April 12-17, 2027
Approved out-of-town training for Officer Bucksath at Muscatuck Urban Training Center October 26-30
Approved purchase of new Ford Interceptor at $46,804 with $38,439.17 from insurance proceeds and remaining balance from community host fund
Accepted Ohio traffic safety grant of $61,866.90
Approved agreement with National Pavement Analysis LLC to evaluate township roads not to exceed $6,495
Approved sending letters to Senator Terry Johnson, Representative Jean Schmidt, and PUCO objecting to Duke Energy rate increase
Approved promotion of Jen Farmer from part-time to full-time at $27.30/hour effective November 1, 2026 with 40 hours vacation allocation

notes: Meeting date of October 13, 2026 is a future date. The community host fund referenced is revenue from a cannabis dispensary approved by the trustees, used here to offset police cruiser replacement costs. The historical society event was mentioned for the coming Sunday. There was light-hearted banter about birthdays and the homecoming parade. Engine 19 remains out of service due to an electrical/programming issue. The Oathkeepers Fire Conference was attended by four fire department members. An executive session covered employee compensation, truck purchase negotiations, and economic development project confidential information. The video title shows '10-13-26' confirming the October 13, 2026 date.
